name: ki-manager
description: Knowledge Item (KI) management MCP server for AI-assisted development. Keeps your codebase self-documenting for AI agents.

workspace.description: Absolute path to the project workspace root (optional — auto-detected from IDE context)

tools.name: ki_status
tools.description: Check which project is active for the current workspace.

tools.name: read_know_file
tools.description: Read a Knowledge Item (KI) file inside .ki-base/.

content.description: Contents of the specified Knowledge Item file

tools.name: write_know_file
tools.description: Create or overwrite a file inside .ki-base/.

content.description: Confirmation message of created or overwritten file

tools.name: edit_know_file
tools.description: Edit a file inside .ki-base/ by replacing text.

content.description: Status message of the edit operation

tools.name: ki_call
tools.description: Universal dispatcher for advanced KI tools (audit_coverage, ki_init_project, generate_dir_index, git_checkpoint, etc.).

content.description: Result output of the dispatched action
